domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible forms before subtraction by finding a common denominator, converting to equivalent fractions, rewriting a whole number with a 0/d fractional part, and/or normalizing a mixed number whose fractional part is nonstandard.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d so fractional parts can be subtracted.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper or otherwise nonstandard fractional part is rewritten to an equivalent standard mixed number before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the quantities are already in directly compatible form and no preparatory rewriting is performed.
Do not tag the actual subtraction once forms are compatible.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun or final simplification of the result.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once forms are compatible, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers before any needed regrouping.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately in a mixed-number or whole-number context.
Tag when the subtraction step produces a zero or negative fractional intermediate that is later handled by regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator, equivalent-fraction rewriting, whole-to-0/d rewriting, or mixed-number normalization.
Do not tag the borrowing/regrouping step itself.
Do not tag reducing or formatting the final answer.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 from the whole part and converting it into fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract directly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into d/d or equivalent fractional units and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used after or in anticipation of a negative fractional difference.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for merely rewriting a whole number as x + 0/d before any need to borrow.
Do not tag for final simplification or final recombination alone.

skills.name: Simplify and express
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction result such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solution combines whole and fractional parts into a final mixed number or integer.
Tag when the final answer is expressed after recognizing that the whole part or fractional part is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction computation itself.
Do not tag preparatory alignment or normalization before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping unless the step is specifically simplifying or formatting the final result.
